As your GSSA, we provide an exclusive, dedicated team committed to fueling your airline's success

For each airline partnership, we establish a dedicated team, focused on delivering tailored GSSA operations that support your growth and success in the Indonesian market.

OUR EXPERTISE

At AVIAVENTURA, our GSSA approaches bring together key advantages that set us apart. From our extensive network to our expertise, we are committed to offering unmatched support for airline partners.

01

Extensive Network

Leverage our strong connections with government bodies, authorities, and travel agencies, ensuring smooth operations and fast access to market opportunities.

02

Expert Team

Our highly skilled and experienced professionals provide dedicated attention, handling all aspects of airline representation and management with precision.

03

Market Insight

Benefit from our deep understanding of Indonesia's market, enabling airlines to tailor their strategies and capture growth in this dynamic region.

04

Accountability and Transparency

We ensures precise and timely sales operations, managing airline passenger sales in Indonesia with full transparency. We guarantee that all sales profits are deposited directly to the airlines promptly, accurately, and without delays.

Travel agency partners

What is more, with AVIAVENTURA, for each new partnership, we setup a new office and form a dedicated team to ensure focused attention & treatment. As soon as the partnership is sealed, we swiftly set up operations—no delays.

01

First, we setup a new office

We immediately setup a fresh new dedicated office located in Jakarta’s prestigious Segitiga Emas district.

02

Then, we assign dedicated team

Each airline receives a dedicated team, consisting of experts with one focused manager.

03

Finally, we provide tailored facilities

From personal drivers for country managers and other custom tailored facilities to meet airline’s needs.
